desc: A block made from pale ribs and cranial bone. Its ivory guise decorates tombs and temples alike
obtain: Reading "Imagine This" (Searching For Hidden Tombs 1/3) adds a hint into the Set List. This block is then obtained by looting the Bone Block in the Hidden Tomb northwest of the Ancient Spire - Springlands.

desc: A new type of timber block for building. The brick accents warm up any space.
ingredients_zh: 烧制砖块 x1、原木 x5
obtain: This block is obtained by looting a silver chest found deep in the sewers beneath Fort Kelvin. The door to access the room with the chest must be picked in order to open.

desc: A Bronze Block commonly utilized in art and science. It inspires greatness when used as a building material.
ingredients_zh: 青铜锭 x1、任意木材 x5
obtain: This block is unlocked by acquiring Bronze Bars for the first time. Bronze Bars can be crafted by combining Copper Bars and Tin Bars in the Smelter or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires.

desc: Only a prestigious castle can be built from such sturdy stone.
ingredients_zh: 贝壳石灰岩 x5、花岗岩 x5

desc: With this greenish castle roof block, nothing stands in the way of your architectural masterpieces
obtain: This block is unlocked after acquiring Shell Limestone.

desc: A washed version of the Rough Stone Block. Exposed to the weather, the stones have lost their rough feature over time.
ingredients_zh: 石头 x5、游牧高地泥土 x5
obtain: Reading "Citywall Blocks" (Fortification 1/2) adds a hint to the Set List. This block is then obtained by looting the Castle Wall Stone Block in the Mining Rift. It is found in a silver chest on a platform hanging over the Rift. Finding this block is the objective of the quest .

desc: A neglected building material which is often used to building high and sturdy walls. This block protected the denizens of many cities before the fall
ingredients_zh: 石头 x8、春之原野泥土 x2
obtain: A hint is placed in the Set List after reading "The Tower Must Reach The Sky!" (A Tower to the Stars 1/1). This block is then obtained by looting the Citywall Block in Fawnsong Frontier. It is found in a silver chest on one of the scaffolds behind the tower guarded by the Scavenger Matron. leads to the same location, but the tower is further in.

desc: A cozy, darker wood block made from conifer logs. It makes you want to hunt in the mountains or to drink hot tea by the fire.
obtain: This block is unlocked by acquiring Conifer Logs for the first time.

desc: Hammer of the Ancients: An archaic building tool fueled by the Flame, capable of quickly erecting various structures around your home.
obtain: The recipe is unlocked by reaching the Return Beacon past the caves after exiting the Cinder Vault for the first time. It is then crafted by Manual Crafting.

desc: Copper adds a certain industrial warmth to your home with its characteristic color and shine.
ingredients_zh: 铜锭 x1、任意木材 x5
obtain: This block is unlocked by acquiring a Copper Bar for the first time. Copper Bars can be crafted by combining Charcoal and Copper Ore in the Smelter or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires. Copper Ore can be found all over Revelwood.

desc: A magical tool capable of adding and removing signs of decay to walls in your base.
ingredients_zh: 青铜锭 x1、石灰石 x1、硬木 x1
obtain: Can be crafted from the Collector survivor, found at the end of the Springlands Hollow Halls during .

desc: Modeled after Kindlewastes city walls. This block is an accurate replica.
obtain: This block is obtained by looting the Desert City Wall Block in Brittlebush. It is found in a silver chest in Emily Fray's tavern in the center of town.

desc: A shingle block in blue hues, used in the angled rooftops of the Kindlewastes.
ingredients_zh: 黏土块 x10、青铜锭 x1、青金石 x1
obtain: This block can be found in Sapphire Strand . It is found in a silver chest on top of the building.

desc: A block of an ancient style, representing the architectural elements of the desert temples.
ingredients_zh: 砂岩 x8、靛蓝植物 x2
obtain: This block is obtained by looting the Desert Temple Block in the South-west Sun Temple. It is found on a skeleton near the Flame Shrine.

desc: A direction sign that you can write on.
A building block that's commonly used by the Drak, specifically the Drak'Dal.
ingredients_zh: 贝壳石灰岩 x9、金锭 x1
obtain: This block is obtained in the Drak'Dal Temple south of Orville in the Veilwater Basin.

desc: A building block that makes it easier to create harsh and visually enticing edges.
obtain: Finding this block is the objective of the quest

desc: An ominous, green glowing building block made from ectoplasm. The construction is reminiscent of stained glass windows.
ingredients_zh: 燧石 x5、灵质碎片 x5
obtain: This block is obtained by looting the Ectoplasm Block in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls. It is found in a silver chest on top of a pillar in the middle of the large collapsed chamber.

desc: A decorative item for everyone's home.
ingredients_zh: 植物纤维 x2、黑火药 x4、木板 x2、钉子 x1

desc: A stone block often used for building sturdy soundproof walls.
obtain: This block is obtained by looting the Fancy Stone Block in Raven's Keep. It is found in a silver chest inside the Keep.

desc: A block made of Fired Brick. It has a dull red color.
obtain: This block is unlocked by acquiring a Fired Brick for the first time. Fired Bricks can be crafted by combining Lump of Clay and Wood Logs in the Kiln or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires. Lump of Clay can be found in Revelwood.

desc:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This Collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Showcase. The showcase must be placed on a wall.
obtain: This collectible is found at Everfrore Keep. Starting from the lowest entrance of the keep on the east side where the flame checkpoint is head south into the keep. Go to the left of the iron gate blocking the path, avoid traps, and lockpick the double door into the storage room. From here immediately head left and up two flights of stairs. Head straight through the door and you are on the other side of the metal gate. Head south and climb the rubble to get up to the next floor. Continue south up the stairs and head to the right. You'll climb another small set of stairs and avoid floor traps. At the end head right up a few stairs and then left through the hole in the rock. On the other side of the rock head up the stairs on the right and make a double left turn back up to the rock. Follow the path under the wooden archway till you get to a dead end then look up to the right to see a zipline. Zip up and climb the grate to the top. Follow the path around the rock to the left continue to follow the path and jump across scaffolding to get to the top of the rock. The piece is buried in the snow next to the grave.

obtain: This collectible is found at Everfrore Keep. Starting from the lowest entrance of the keep on the east side where the flame checkpoint is head south into the keep. Go to the left of the iron gate blocking the path, avoid traps, and lockpick the double door into the storage room. From here immediately head left and up two flights of stairs. Head straight through the door and you are on the other side of the metal gate. Head south and climb the rubble to get up to the next floor. Continue south up the stairs and head to the right. You'll climb another small set of stairs and avoid floor traps. At the end head left again and run down to the tree. From here head left down the hanging stairs. At the bottom head right and then lockpick the metal gate door on the right. The piece is inside.

This Collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Showcase. The showcase must be placed on a wall.
obtain: This collectible is found at Everfrore Keep. Starting from the lowest entrance of the keep on the east side where the flame checkpoint is head south into the keep. Go to the left of the iron gate blocking the path, avoid traps, and lockpick the double door into the storage room. From here immediately head left and up two flights of stairs. Head straight through the door and you are on the other side of the metal gate. Turn around to face the way you came from storage and look up to see a balcony with another door. Climb up and lockpick the door to gain entry. Head through the room and go through the wall opening outside onto the scaffolding. Head left around the scaffolding and climb the metal grate. Head into the bedroom and go smash through the wooden barred door. The piece is on the balcony here.

obtain: This collectible is found at Everfrore Keep. Starting from the lowest entrance of the keep on the east side where the flame checkpoint is head south into the keep. Go to the left of the iron gate blocking the path, avoid traps, and lockpick the double door into the storage room. From here immediately head left and up two flights of stairs. Head straight through the door and you are on the other side of the metal gate. Head south and climb the rubble to get up to the next floor. Continue south up the stairs and head to the right. You'll climb another small set of stairs and avoid floor traps. At the end head right up a few stairs and head straight up and around the stairs and pass through the stone arch walkway where the skull hanging is. This leads to another long courtyard, head to the end of the courtyard and you'll see a locked door on the left small tower and an open doorway on the right tower. Head through the right tower doorway and cut left to get to the other side of the door. You'll then come to a destroyed wooden bridge cross it and head to the other side. Follow the junk path inside around to the left and head up into the open doorway on the right. From here head up two flights of stairs into another room, then head up two small sets of stairs leading to an opening outside. Head outside then go to the right under the wood beam. Zip up to the scaffolding at the end. Then head right and zip up again to the second wood scaffolding. Head up the stairs, avoid the floor traps, and then outside through the doorway. Circle around to the right into the courtyard. There will be a Scavenger Tyrant. Defeat them and on the other side of the courtyard you will see an opening in the wall with stairs. Head up, through the hall, up again, and then circle around to the right into the higher courtyard. Take the stairs on the left all the way up and head through the locked door of the small home at the end. Take the stairs up and grab the piece from the wood balcony.

At the end head right up a few stairs and head straight up and around the stairs and pass through the stone arch walkway where the skull hanging is. This leads to another long courtyard, head part of the way down and head left into the ruins of a building. There is a opening that should take you down to a lower floor. Pass through the doorway and head left into the hall. Head to the other end of the hall and there will be a door on the right side. Lockpick the door and head in, follow the stairs down and turn left, the piece will be at the end with the mycelium growth.

You'll see a blocking metal grate head around to the right through the gap. Cross to the other side and cut left around the wall and you'll see the piece close to the blocking grate.

ingredients_zh: 石头 x5、净化黏液 x5
obtain: This block is unlocked by acquiring Purified Slime for the first time. Purified Slime can be crafted by combining Charcoal, Salt, Toxic Slime, and Wood Acid in the Ectoplasm Press. Toxic Slime can be obtained by mining the green deadly waste inside of Hollow Halls.

Timbering is an ancient building technique that was very popular for its decorative effect.
obtain: After visiting Morwenna and talking to the Cade Hawthorn with the "Building Diadwyn" option, a hint is added in the Set List. This block is then obtained by looting the Half-Timbered Block in Diadwyn. It is found in a silver chest in the middle of the town.

obtain: This block is obtained by killing and looting the Scavenger Matron in Ocean's Heart, which is north-east of the Kindlewastes Ancient Spire.

desc: The characteristic building material used inside the Hollow Halls. The originators of this architectural style are unknown and forgotten.
obtain: This block is obtained by looting the Hollow Halls Block in the Springlands Hollow Halls. It is found in multiple silver chests in the rooms on the sides of the hall shortly before the Collector.

obtain: This block is unlocked by acquiring Iron Bars for the first time. Iron Bars can be crafted by combining Iron Ore and Charcoal in the Smelter or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Kindlewastes Ancient Spire. Iron Ore can be found in certain mines and cave passages in the Kindlewastes.

obtain: This block is obtained by looting the Limestone Block in Surat's Rest. It is found in a silver chest at the top of the old watchtower on the east side of town.

Tarring the Wood Logs makes them more resistant and perfect for rooftops.
obtain: This block is unlocked by acquiring Tar for the first time. Tar can be crafted by combining Wood Logs and Dirt in the Charcoal Kiln, obtained by cooking food for too long at a Campfire, or found in the world.

desc: Made from straw and enhanced with tar. This is an enhanced version of the Plant Fiber Roof Block, especially good to protect from the elements
obtain: This block is unlocked by acquiring Straw for the first time. Straw can be obtained by harvesting Wheat.

desc: A Tarred Wood Block. Now only the shingles are missing.
obtain: This block is unlocked by acquiring Tar for the first time. Tar can be crafted by combining Wood Logs and Dirt in the Charcoal Kiln, obtained by cooking food for too long at a Campfire, or found in the world.

desc: Weathered stones, either built or claimed by the Vukah. The yellow-tinged moss in the furrows hints at its age.
ingredients_zh: 石头 x8、春之原野泥土 x2
obtain: Found in Treetop Vukah Settlement

desc: A wall sign that you can write on.
In ancient times, these blocks were used to build dungeons and catacombs. Nowadays, they are in bad condition, but still serve their purpose.
obtain: A hint appears in the Set List after reading "It Crawls Beneath My Flesh" (A Rumble in the Catacombs 2/2). This block is then obtained by looting the Weathered Stone Block in Bramblespine Boneyard. It is found in a silver chest towards the end of the Catacomb, before the Fell Thunderbrute.

desc: Bathed in waterproofing liquids, this stone block is mostly used for Elixir Wells.
ingredients_zh: 砂岩 x8、雾瘴液体 x2
obtain: This block is obtained by looting the Well Block in a Kindlewastes Elixir Well. It is found in a silver chest near the Shroud Root, guarded by a Fell Monstrosity.

desc: A building block crafted from Warm White Glowing Substance. Its radiance brightens up any space.
ingredients_zh: 石头 x5、白色发光物质 x5
obtain: This block is unlocked by acquiring for the first time. White Glowing Substance can be crafted using Dirt, Mycelium, Bonemeal, and Wood Acid at the Alchemist.
